text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. 黑色皮手套一对
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Professional photorealistic wardrobe catalog image, portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. Pure white seamless background, soft studio lighting, subtle contact shadow, accurate textile texture and original colors. Entire item(s) fully visible with generous white margins, no clipping. No text, watermark, label, collage, runway, background decor, person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger or stand. Hollow invisible mannequin garment presentation with empty openings; never fill openings with skin or a mannequin. Single independent accessory product photo: 黑色皮手套一对. Show this accessory alone, all straps/chains and clasp complete. Matching earrings or gloves are a pair; otherwise exactly one object. Natural three-quarter product view, centered and large. No clothing, extra accessories, display body, head, hand, face or packaging. Input image 1 is material and design reference ONLY: select accessory 黑色皮手套一对 from image 37, outfit at right. Accurately preserve its visible shape, color, material, hardware and detail, conservatively complete hidden portions. Do not copy the person or other objects.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
